text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the final day of summer camp, but

Matikanetannhauser is nowhere to be
found. I
search high and low for her,
until...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Is it that late already?! Sorry! I was
just
looking for something...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Just some things I found yesterday but
forgot to
bring back with me. Oh, where
are they?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She points toward a row of several
spider
conches.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, they're seashells shaped like
spiders! They're
so cute and spiky!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's use them to decorate your
office! They
can remind us of this
summer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All things considered, this year's summer
camp
comes to a close with
Matikanetannhauser in high
spirits.
